asset.name: ContextMenu
asset.description: The pointer- or keyboard-invoked menu positioned around an interaction point, with viewport collision handling, nested actions, and awareness of the current selection.

requires.reason: Item semantics, keyboard model, and dismissal are shared.

rationale: The keyboard path is the part usually missed: a context menu reachable only by right-click is inaccessible, so the context-menu key and a documented shortcut are part of the contract.
